verdict.rationale: OpenHands explicitly supports event-triggered automations: workflows triggered by GitHub, Slack, Jira, Linear events and webhooks/schedules, with concrete examples like watching for PR labels, failed workflows, security alerts, and Slack mentions to auto-trigger agent actions. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these automation triggers working reliably, and detail on user-defined custom rule/condition logic beyond the prebuilt integration triggers.
